recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5959 unless the commented CDA profile is deliberately reactivated or migrated in a separate scoped task.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive PA change request from DSTU1 asking to remove the Location collection from Organization, keep the association from Location.managingOrganization, and add usage notes/examples explaining Organization and Location hierarchies.
initial_application: Commit 11d7e08a5b3805e4493ed2a9e6e8108e4fae52c5 applied the core change by marking Organization.location for removal and adding a Location.managingOrganization usage comment. Commit e223eb751600091ff2f6b88383d089ba15ba9490 removed the old Organization.location path from a then-current profile after the core change.
additional_context: Location and Organization are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. The only current source hit for Organization.location is source/profiles/cda.profile.xml, but the CDA profile entry is commented out in source/fhir.ini and is not a current build target. Later PA issues FHIR-26027 and FHIR-26381 clarified the Organization/Location boundary without restoring Organization.location.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current Organization source has no Organization.location element or search parameter, Location.managingOrganization and its Location organization search parameter are present, and current narrative already explains Organization versus Location hierarchy usage.

related_jiras.note: Later Published PA clarification says Location represents where a service is performed and Organization can represent who performed it, reinforcing the same boundary.
Later Applied PA clarification distinguishes Organization, HealthcareService, and Location roles without restoring Organization.location.
